#!/bin/sh
# Merge offset-stamped TSV event logs into a UTC timeline.
# This intentionally uses only POSIX shell and awk for compatibility with Alpine.
set -eu

BASE=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    set -- "$BASE"/logs/*.tsv
fi

work=$(mktemp "$BASE/.timeline-work.XXXXXX")
out=$(mktemp "$BASE/.timeline-out.XXXXXX")
reject=$(mktemp "$BASE/.timeline-reject.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$work" "$out" "$reject"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
: > "$reject"

awk -v rejected="$reject" '
function leap(y) {
    return (y % 4 == 0 && (y % 100 != 0 || y % 400 == 0))
}
function month_days(y, m) {
    if (m == 2) return 28 + leap(y)
    if (m == 4 || m == 6 || m == 9 || m == 11) return 30
    return 31
